# Jubilab

> Jubilab is early-stage software that keeps a local record of how a scientific result was made: the run, inputs and parameters behind it. You can trace a result back, compare two runs, and see what the record does not know. It runs on your own machine, and its server makes no outbound network calls. It links to your data where it lives instead of copying it, and it does not replace your pipelines. Access is by invitation only, and there are no user accounts yet. The demo project on the website uses synthetic data.

## Pages

- [Jubilab home page](https://jubilab.io/): what Jubilab is, how it works (link, record, ask), a demo project on synthetic data, and the early-access request form
- [How it works](https://jubilab.io/#how): the three steps, link your data, record each run, ask what made a result
- [See it on a demo project](https://jubilab.io/#product): trace a result, compare two runs, and how each fact is marked verified, inferred, manual or unknown
- [Where this is going](https://jubilab.io/#next): planned direction, labelled on the page as not in the product today
- [Request early access](https://jubilab.io/#access): the invitation-only early-access form

## Optional

- [Privacy](https://jubilab.io/privacy/): what the website and the early-access form collect, including the Cloudflare Web Analytics service the site always uses and Google Analytics, which runs only if the visitor accepts the cookie notice
- [Terms](https://jubilab.io/terms/): terms for using the website and requesting early access
